provenance.title: THE 3D INDEX OF AN IDEAL TRIANGULATION AND ANGLE STRUCTURES

candidates.statement: Generalized angle structures are linearizations of the gluing equations, that may be used to construct complete hyperbolic structures, and intimately connected with the theory of normal surfaces on $M$ [@Jaco].

On the other hand, an ideal triangulation that contains an edge which belongs to exactly one (or two) ideal tetrahedra does not admit a strict angle structure since the angle equations around that edge should add to $2$.
candidates.section_title: On the topological invariance of the index
